stories.title: Islamabad High Court Reserves Judgment on FBR Production Monitoring System
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has reserved its decision regarding numerous constitutional petitions that challenge the Federal Board of Revenue’s electronic production monitoring system. A division bench composed of Justice Khadim Hussain Soomro and Justice Umair Malik presided over the hearings involving over 300 industrial units from sectors such as textiles, beverages, cooking oil, packaged milk, and food processing.

The contesting industrial units challenged the constitutional validity and legality of the production monitoring mechanism introduced under Section 40C of the Sales Tax Act, 1990. Petitioners argued that the FBR lacks the proper authority to install electronic monitoring devices on their premises, raised concerns about the financial expenses tied to the equipment, and claimed the system disrupts their regular business operations.

Govenerment counsel Hafiz Ehsaan Ahmad Khokhar defended the statutory authority and legislative competence behind Section 40C. He explained that the provision was enacted in 2013 to enhance the tracking of industrial production, sales, and stocks while curbing tax evasion. Khokhar detailed that the framework relies on specific subsections and Chapter XIV-BA of the Sales Tax Rules, 2006, which govern video analytics and digital-eye technology.

Khokhar noted that similar monitoring systems are already active in major sectors like tobacco, sugar, cement, and fertilizer without prior judicial intervention. He argued that expanding the mechanism ensures verified production, prevents under-invoicing, and promotes a fair marketplace. Following the detailed arguments presented by both sides, the bench officially reserved its judgment.

stories.title: PHDEC and GPI Collaborate to Expand Balochistan Horticultural Exports
stories.summary:
Muhammad Naseer, CEO of the Pakistan Horticulture Development and Export Company, visited the Green Pakistan Initiative head office on October 29, 2026. During the visit, project director Asif Khan briefed officials on the horticultural processing and storage infrastructure currently under development across Balochistan to boost regional agricultural exports.

The infrastructure project spans 22 locations across 20 districts, targeting major fruits and vegetables such as apples, dates, tomatoes, onions, pomegranates, grapes, plums, and cherries. Each designated location features a cold storage capacity of 1,000 tonnes alongside processing rates ranging from 1 to 5 tonnes per hour. Eight of these facilities are slated to begin operations in the coming months.

Naseer praised the initiative for strengthening horticultural value chains and supporting traceable, commercial-scale production. He suggested prioritizing items like date paste, date syrup, dried onions, tomato pulp, and apple cider for export through partnerships with local traders. Khan endorsed the recommendations and confirmed participation in the upcoming FoodAg exhibition.

The GPI plans to display its value-added goods at the FoodAg event, scheduled for November 23–26 in Karachi. This engagement aims to connect international buyers with Pakistan's horticultural output, while Naseer reaffirmed PHDEC's dedication to improving market access for regional producers.

stories.title: UN Women Pakistan Recognizes 17 Honorees at 2026 WEPs Awards
stories.summary:
The biennial Women’s Empowerment Principles Awards in Pakistan recently celebrated 17 winners and runner-up recipients across seven distinct categories. Selected from a pool of 52 nationwide applicants ranging from small enterprises to large corporations, the honorees were recognized for advancing gender equality throughout their respective business value chains.

The 2026 awards ceremony was hosted by UN Women Pakistan in collaboration with Derien, Soorty, and media partner GEO. Jamshed M Kazi, the UN Women Pakistan Country Representative, emphasized that true business success involves transforming lives and removing barriers for female leadership. Syed Nasir Hussain Shah, Minister for Local Government and chief guest at the event, noted that women's economic participation remains essential for the country's social and economic development.

Keynote speaker Nishat Fatima, CEO of South Air, stressed that empowering women drives organizational innovation and strengthens the economy. The event honored initiatives promoting inclusive workplaces, gender-responsive products, and inclusive procurement, highlighting the role of technology and small and medium-sized enterprises in fostering equal opportunities.

National winners from the Pakistan event will advance to the regional 2026 Asia-Pacific WEPs Awards, subject to final eligibility checks. The regional ceremony is scheduled to be broadcast on December 1, 2026. Globally, over 13,400 companies participate in the WEPs directory, with more than 190 companies representing Pakistan within the network.

stories.title: Sindh Food Authority Fines Karachi Cafe Rs200,000 Over Violations
stories.summary:
The Sindh Food Authority has penalized a cafe located in Karachi’s Defence area with a fine of Rs200,000 following routine health inspections. The penalty was issued after food safety officials discovered multiple expired items and strands of hair inside various food products at the establishment.

The inspection was conducted by an SFA team led by the Deputy Director South. This enforcement action took place across several cafes situated in the Defence neighborhood within the city's South district, operating under the direct instructions of Sindh Minister for Food Makhdoom Mehboob-uz-Zaman.

During the targeted checks within the South district, the food safety team identified serious violations regarding food quality and hygiene standards. Consequently, authorities imposed the monetary fine on the defaulting cafe to deter future safety breaches and protect public health.

stories.title: Islamabad Police Face Ongoing Street Crime Challenges Across Multiple Districts
stories.summary:
Street crimes and vehicle thefts continued unabated across the federal capital of Islamabad during the past week, according to crime data compiled for the period. Multiple police stations throughout the city recorded numerous incidents involving motorcycle and car thefts, street crime, robberies, and dacoities, demonstrating that unlawful activities were widespread rather than limited to a single neighborhood.

Specifically, the Sumbal Police Station documented the highest number of motorcycle thefts with five reported cases, closely followed by Sawan Town with four incidents. Other jurisdictions such as Ramana reported a diverse range of offenses including motorcycle theft, car theft, street crime, and dacoity, while the Secretariat Police Station noted two motorcycle thefts. Additional cases spanning various criminal categories were officially logged by stations in Aabpara, Margalla, Koral, Khanna, Tarnol, Sangjani, Industrial Area, Sadar Mandi, Noon, Shahzad Town, Humak, Lehtrar Bheer, and Bhara Kahu.

Furthermore, incidents of robbery and dacoity took place in several designated areas, including Shalimar, Golra, Sumbal, Tarnol, Sangjani, Shahzad Town, Koral, Humak, Lehtrar Bheer, and Nilore. These widespread occurrences emphasize the continuous difficulties encountered by Islamabad law enforcement agencies in managing and curbing vehicle theft and street criminality.

Despite repeated security arrangements and enforcement measures implemented by authorities, criminal elements remain active across various police jurisdictions. The continuous reporting of these offenses highlights the persistent security challenges that local police forces must address to protect citizens and property throughout the capital.

stories.title: Competition Commission of Pakistan Clears Nestlé and Platinum Equity Venture
stories.summary:
The Competition Commission of Pakistan (CCP) has officially approved a proposed joint venture involving Nestlé Pakistan Limited's bottled water business and an entity controlled by Platinum Equity. Issued on October 16, 2026, the merger order authorizes the transaction under Section 31(1)(d)(i) of the Competition Act of 2010, following a Phase-I assessment that identified no horizontal or vertical market overlaps within the country.

Under the restructuring plan, Nestlé Pakistan will transfer its bottled water operations—which currently market products under the Nestlé Pure Life brand—as a going concern to a newly formed, wholly owned subsidiary referred to as "Newco Pakistan." In exchange, Nestlé Pakistan will obtain shares in this subsidiary, which will subsequently be routed to an upstream Nestlé entity. This step integrates the Pakistani water division into a broader international Nestlé Waters structure tied to the upcoming global joint venture.

Globally, a Luxembourg special purpose vehicle named Forward I S.à r.l., incorporated on July 1, 2026, is acquiring a shareholding in WPB JVco S.à r.l. Established on July 2, 2026, WPB JVco will be jointly controlled by Nestlé and Forward I. Forward I itself has no independent operations and is ultimately overseen by Platinum Equity LLC through specific investment entities. Although Platinum-controlled firms already operate in Pakistan within IT distribution, pharmaceuticals, educational materials, and industrial power generation, the CCP determined these sectors do not overlap with the bottled water market.

Consequently, the transaction leaves existing market shares unchanged, creates no entry barriers, and avoids lessening competition or establishing a dominant market position. The clearance remains strictly limited to merger reviews under Section 11, leaving matters outside the CCP's authority subject to other applicable legal frameworks.

stories.title: PPEPCA Hosts Conference Highlighting Petroleum Sector Corporate Social Responsibility Contributions
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Petroleum Exploration & Production Companies Association (PPEPCA) hosted its Corporate Social Responsibility Conference in Rawalpindi on Saturday. The gathering convened senior exploration and production company representatives, government officials, corporate leaders, and other stakeholders to showcase the energy sector's ongoing investments in community welfare and sustainable development across its operating areas.

During the event, participating exploration and production firms delivered presentations highlighting various projects focused on education, healthcare, clean drinking water, skills development, community infrastructure, and environmental sustainability. These initiatives aim to improve local access to essential services and generate socioeconomic opportunities for underserved and remote populations.

Addressing the attendees, Nasir Khan, CEO of KPOGCL and president of the PPEPCA corporate affairs committee, emphasized the significance of coordinated social investments and responsible corporate engagement. He commended the industry's contributions to social uplift and public services while stressing the need to maintain development interventions and maximize long-term community benefits. Ibrar Khan, secretary-general of PPEPCA, also spoke, noting the association's role in uniting member companies to share best practices and ensure corporate investments yield tangible improvements for local residents.

Participants and government stakeholders praised the initiative, recognizing how industry efforts successfully complement public sector development programs. The conference concluded with expressions of gratitude to the organizers, corporate representatives, and attendees, reaffirming the commitment of Pakistan's energy sector to fostering regional prosperity and welfare.

stories.title: Peshawar Demolishes Over 950 Structures in Massive Anti-Encroachment Operation
stories.summary:
Peshawar authorities are executing a large-scale anti-encroachment campaign targeting illegal constructions along Ring Road and surrounding neighborhoods. Led by the District Administration of Peshawar alongside the Peshawar Development Authority and other relevant departments, the joint operation has successfully demolished more than 950 shops, markets, and unauthorized structures using heavy machinery.

The sweeping clearance operations are actively taking place across key locations, including Jamil Chowk, Pir Zakori Flyover, Pushtakhara Chowk, and Kabootar Chowk. The primary objectives of the initiative are to reclaim government land, widen public roads and passages, eliminate traffic bottlenecks, and enhance travel convenience and civic facilities for the general public.

District officials emphasize that these coordinated measures are designed to ease traffic congestion along Ring Road, reduce citizen travel times, and uphold the rule of law. By clearing public spaces of illegal obstacles, the administration aims to protect state property and significantly improve urban infrastructure and daily life in the city.

Deputy Commissioner Peshawar affirmed that the public-interest campaign will proceed without interruption and stated that strict preventative measures will be enforced to stop any re-establishment of encroachments on cleared state property. He reiterated that indiscriminate operations targeting illegal occupations will continue across other parts of Peshawar with no compromises made on public welfare or government land protection.

stories.title: Karachi Met Office Warns of Health Risks From Wide Temperature Swings
stories.summary:
Dry and hot weather conditions persisted in Karachi on Saturday, accompanied by an official warning from the Met Office regarding significant temperature fluctuations between day and night. Authorities cautioned that these sharp swings could present health hazards for both human populations and livestock, prompting advisories for residents to take necessary precautions.

The city recorded a maximum daytime temperature of 38 degrees Celsius with a low humidity level of 17 percent. Overnight, the temperature dropped to 21 degrees Celsius while humidity climbed to 42 percent, placing the maximum daytime reading at 3.9 degrees above normal. Meteorological officials stressed that the substantial gap between daytime warmth and nighttime coolness requires individuals to closely monitor the well-being of themselves and their animals.

Looking ahead, upper and central districts of Sindh are expected to experience dry weather coupled with cool nights. Meanwhile, southern districts will likely see warm and dry conditions alongside cool nighttime temperatures. Sunday's forecast anticipates warm, dry weather with daytime maximums ranging from 34 to 36 degrees Celsius and humidity levels fluctuating between 50 percent during the day and 75 percent at night.

By Monday, conditions may shift to include dry weather, misty mornings, and maximum temperatures reaching 33 to 35 degrees Celsius. Humidity is projected to measure between 70 and 80 percent in the morning hours, tapering down to 40 and 50 percent by the evening. The Met Office continues to monitor these atmospheric patterns across the region as seasonal transitions bring changing weather conditions.

stories.title: Federal Minister Attaullah Tarar Highlights Pakistan's Improving International Image Through Sports
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Information and Broadcasting Attaullah Tarar stated on Saturday that Pakistan is experiencing heightened economic activity, expanding diplomatic engagement, and a revival of international sports. Speaking at the Pakistan Tourism, Sports and Family Festival held at F-9 Park in Islamabad, the minister emphasized that these developments showcase a positive shift in the nation's global reputation.

Tarar credited the diplomatic and economic progress to the vision of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and the efforts of Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir. He noted that visits by foreign dignitaries and successful international sporting fixtures highlight the country's deepening integration with the international community. Recent sporting achievements highlighted by the minister include a tri-nation cricket series, tours by the England and Sri Lankan cricket squads, a newly launched hockey league, squash championships, and various youth talent programs.

The festival also featured a traditional tent-pegging competition, known locally as neza bazi, which Tarar described as a vital component of Pakistan's cultural heritage. He expressed strong support for the participation of women and young girls in the event. Prime Minister's Coordinator on Tourism Sardar Yasir Ilyas Khan also attended the gathering, which was designed to offer residents healthy recreational activities and family entertainment.

Concluding his remarks, Tarar reiterated that the government remains fully dedicated to supporting sports, tourism, and cultural initiatives. He stated that such events not only foster national development and create opportunities for youth across all societal segments, but also help strengthen connections to the country's cultural traditions and promote a positive image abroad.

stories.title: JazzWorld Reports Strong Third Quarter Financial Results for 2026
stories.summary:
JazzWorld announced a total revenue of PKR 144.9 billion for the third quarter of 2026, marking a 26.6 percent increase compared to the same period in the previous year. Digital services revenue climbed 47.9 percent year-over-year to PKR 58.1 billion, representing 40.1 percent of the total revenue, up from 34.3 percent previously. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization rose 23.9 percent to PKR 65.2 billion, while telecommunications and infrastructure revenue expanded 15.5 percent to PKR 86.8 billion.

The company served 76.4 million mobile customers, reflecting a 5.1 percent annual growth, and its combined 4G and 5G customer base reached 59.5 million. Average data usage per user grew by 11.7 percent to 8.4 GB, and Jazz's premium digital brand, ROX, attained 3.3 million active users. Total investments surged by 68.9 percent to PKR 20.9 billion, which included PKR 18.6 billion allocated toward telecommunications and infrastructure to support spectrum deployment, network capacity enhancement, and the rollout of over 1,000 5G sites.

Financial services revenue experienced a 67.6 percent increase to PKR 43.4 billion across JazzCash, Mobilink Bank, and JazzSure Insurance, driven by gains in lending, payments, and merchant services. The gross loan portfolio for the Pakistani financial services sector expanded by 51.9 percent to PKR 134.6 billion as of September 30. JazzCash accounted for 65 million branchless banking accounts, processed a Gross Transaction Value of PKR 6.9 trillion, and issued over 230,000 nano-loans daily during the quarter.

Lifestyle ventures also showed significant user growth, with SIMOSA reaching 36.3 million active users, Tamasha recording 33.9 million active users, and FikrFree covering 16.8 million unique policyholders. Chief Executive Officer Aamir Ibrahim emphasized that continuous network investment remains central to the platform's growth, noting that emerging artificial intelligence capabilities will help bridge the intelligence divide by allowing users to seek assistance in their native languages.

stories.title: Sindh Governor Urges Industrialists to Create Jobs for Balochistan Youth
stories.summary:
Sindh Governor Syed Muhammad Nehal Hashmi has called upon industrialists to support employment initiatives for the youth of Balochistan, emphasizing that stronger collaboration between the government and the private sector is vital for their economic empowerment and integration into national development. He made these remarks during a Saturday meeting at the Governor's House with various industrialists, the NAVTTC Sindh director-general, and Dr. Fahad Shafiq, the Sindh Coordinator of the Prime Minister's Youth Programme.

The discussions focused heavily on preparing young individuals from Balochistan for jobs in both domestic industries and international markets through specialized technical and vocational training programs tailored to industry standards. During the session, the NAVTTC Sindh director-general updated the governor on ongoing educational frameworks aimed at bridging trained workers with employers in local sectors while facilitating pathways to overseas employment.

Governor Hashmi welcomed the prime minister's initiative, noting that equipping the younger generation with market-driven skills and ensuring access to dignified work remain primary objectives for the administration. He stressed that bringing Balochistan's youth into the mainstream economy requires active participation from the private sector, which can help define workforce demands and generate necessary employment opportunities across multiple fields.

The meeting drew representatives from several major economic sectors, including automobile manufacturing, construction, furniture, pharmaceuticals, packaging, education, and banking. Officials expressed optimism that coordinated efforts between state institutions and private entities will produce concrete employment results and significantly boost the country's overall economic progress.

stories.title: Trump Asks UFC Chief Dana White to Be Press Secretary
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated on Saturday that he requested Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White to take on the role of White House press secretary. Trump also called on White to bring along six current or former UFC titleholders as assistants to help defend the administration against the political opposition. The requested athletes include Islam Makhachev and Khabib Nurmagomedov from Russia's Dagestan region, Americans Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier, and Kayla Harrison, as well as Brazilian-born American citizen Amanda Nunes. 

The announcement follows the recent departure of former White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia, who was let go from the position less than a week after starting. Zacharia faced public scrutiny after acknowledging she failed the bar exam, despite previously describing herself as a lawyer and listing herself as general counsel for a California-based conservative nonprofit. 

Neither Dana White nor the UFC's parent company, TKO Group Holdings, immediately responded to requests for comment regarding Trump's proposal. The unconventional recruitment pitch underscores Trump's ongoing alignment with prominent public figures and sports personalities. 

Trump made the remarks on Truth Social, praising White as a violent fighter and warrior while emphasizing the need for robust defenders in his administration. The situation highlights ongoing personnel shifts within the White House as the administration navigates political pressures and public scrutiny.

stories.title: Israeli President Tasks Rival Gadi Eisenkot to Form Government
stories.summary:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog on Saturday selected Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's main rival, to attempt to form a new government. The decision follows a deadlocked national election held on October 27 that left neither leader with a straightforward path to securing a parliamentary majority. Netanyahu's religious-nationalist coalition lost its majority but remained the largest bloc in the 120-seat Knesset, winning 53 seats overall, while his Likud party captured 27 seats.

Eisenkot, a former military chief, received endorsements from factions comprising 67 Knesset members, including Arab minority parties that won an unprecedented 19 seats. Although Eisenkot has declined formal alliances with Arab parties, their leaders nominated him first due to opposition to Netanyahu and his far-right allies. In contrast, factions backing Netanyahu accounted for 46 Knesset members, while seven lawmakers made no recommendation. 

Following his formal appointment at the President's Residence, Eisenkot faces a 28-day window to forge a governing coalition, with a potential 14-day extension. Potential pathways include a minority government supported externally by Arab parties, a coalition with ultra-Orthodox parties, or a unity government with Netanyahu, though analysts consider these options unlikely. 

If Eisenkot fails to build a coalition within the allotted timeframe, other candidates may be given an opportunity. The entire parliamentary process has a deadline of approximately 100 days, after which new elections must be held if no government is successfully formed.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Advocates for Tougher Coaching in Women's Basketball
stories.summary:
WNBA player Sophie Cunningham recently used an episode of her podcast, 'No Hesitation,' to advocate for more rigorous coaching methods for female basketball athletes. Cunningham argued against treating female players with excessive leniency, emphasizing that strict accountability and direct criticism are essential for professionals to reach their full potential. She recalled that her own career success stemmed from coaches who refused to let her slip and held her strictly accountable for mistakes.

The discussion arose after co-host and sports trainer Drew Hanlen shared that he had previously been instructed to ease up on elite female clients compared to male athletes. Hanlen maintained that he rejected this advice to train players to the best of his ability regardless of gender. Cunningham agreed with this approach while noting that effective demanding coaching requires athletes to accept criticism constructively and take personal ownership of their growth.

Cunningham noted that such coaching comes from mentors who genuinely care about an athlete's development. Reflecting on her own background, she mentioned playing under at least seven head coaches since high school, including WNBA figures Stephanie White, Sandy Brondello, Vanessa Nygaard, and Nate Tibbetts. She also highlighted an experience with her college coach, Robin Pingeton, who disciplined her with a grueling stair climber workout after feeling Cunningham rushed a study hall assignment.

The podcast statements add to Cunningham's history of outspoken commentary. Previously, her public remarks regarding transgender athletes competing in the women's division sparked significant controversy and prolonged debate within the WNBA community.

stories.title: President Herzog Nominates Gadi Eisenkot to Form Government
stories.summary:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog designated Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party and primary challenger to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, to form a government following a deadlocked election. Netanyahu's religious-nationalist coalition dropped to 53 seats in the October 27 election, falling short of the 61-seat majority required, though Likud secured 27 seats to remain the largest single party in the 120-seat Knesset. Eisenkot's Yashar party became the second-largest with 21 seats, while his four-party centre-left to right-wing bloc won 48 seats.

Despite declining to join forces with Arab parties, Eisenkot secured the most endorsements because Arab leaders, opposing Netanyahu's policies, nominated him to attempt government formation first. President Herzog's spokesperson confirmed the invitation, initiating a 28-day negotiation period with a possible 14-day extension. Eisenkot's difficult options include a minority government with external Arab support, a coalition with ultra-Orthodox parties, or a unity government with Netanyahu, though analysts view all options as improbable.

Eisenkot, 66, is the son of Moroccan immigrants and would become Israel's first Mizrahi prime minister if successful. A media-shy former military chief who entered politics in 2022, Eisenkot briefly served in Netanyahu's wartime cabinet following the October 7, 2023, Hamas attacks before returning to the opposition. He has since strongly criticized Netanyahu's leadership and Gaza military campaign, vowing not to serve alongside him.

Eisenkot's personal and political stance is heavily shaped by the conflict, having lost a son and two nephews fighting in Gaza. On the campaign trail, he emphasized his security background, referenced his 'Dahiyeh doctrine' of disproportionate military response from the 2006 Lebanon war, and expressed opposition to settler violence and far-right figures Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich.

stories.title: Anthropic Embeds Invisible Watermarks in Claude AI Text
stories.summary:
Anthropic has implemented a hidden tracking feature across all text generated by its Claude artificial intelligence models. Systems released since early August already feature this capability, and the company is updating older models ahead of a December deadline set by strict European Union regulations, specifically Article 50 of the EU AI Act. Outputs from models such as Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, and Sonnet 4.6 feature the machine-readable mark, while updates for older systems like Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, and Haiku 4.5 are scheduled through November.

The watermark is embedded at the core model level, meaning users cannot disable it across official web applications, API connections, or third-party cloud hosts including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud. Anthropic utilizes a modified variation of Google's SynthID technology, which subtly adjusts word choices to form a mathematical pattern within the text. According to company documents, this signature survives basic copying and pasting, though extensive editing or translation can disrupt the hidden pattern.

The company emphasized that the watermarks contain no personal user data or conversation history. Presently, ordinary users cannot verify these text signatures, as Anthropic has restricted its detection tool to a private preview intended for law enforcement, researchers, and media organizations. Technical limitations remain, as API developers can bypass the tracking if settings like temperature and top_p deviate from default values, and the system cannot differentiate between wholly AI-generated text and human-written text that underwent AI grammar checking.

This global deployment contrasts with competitors like OpenAI, which enforces watermarks exclusively for European ChatGPT users and keeps the feature optional for API clients. The rollout matters because it highlights growing regulatory pressures on major AI developers to ensure transparency and traceability for machine-generated content, setting a significant precedent for international technology compliance.

stories.title: Clashes Erupt in Paris During Fresh Anti-Government Protests Across France
stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators participated in rallies across France to voice ongoing frustration with the rising cost of living. Official interior ministry figures recorded 146,000 participants nationwide, including 46,000 in Paris, while union estimates placed the total at 250,000 protesters with 75,000 in the capital. These turnouts were lower than the previous three weekends but followed a large union mobilization on Thursday. As the demonstration in Paris concluded at Place de la Nation, security forces deployed tear gas after a group of 200 violent individuals attacked officers who were arresting a person for setting fire to a trash bin. The government deployed approximately 70,000 security personnel ahead of the weekend following severe riots on October 17. Meanwhile, authorities banned a separate demonstration planned by the Yellow Vests movement at Place de la Concorde, arresting several individuals including coordinators Benjamin Ball and Azelma Sigaux. In Lyon, police also used tear gas to disperse an unauthorized gathering blocking a city center road. The protest wave, which began in late September with high school and university students demanding better conditions, continues to pressure the government amid a heavy national debt pile. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu is scheduled to meet with unions and employer federations on Monday to discuss wages and purchasing power, ahead of a planned education strike on Tuesday. With presidential elections five months away, polls indicate that far-right candidate Marine Le Pen is a leading figure, alongside hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon.

stories.title: Balochistan Minister Defends FWO and Clarifies Chief Minister's Remarks
stories.summary: Balochistan Planning Minister Mir Zahoor Ahmad Buledi stated that recent criticisms of the Frontier Works Organisation by Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti were taken out of context. The clarification follows remarks made in late October by National Party leader Dr Abdul Malik Baloch, who criticized the awarding of road project contracts and alleged that the FWO prioritized its own preferences. During that assembly session, CM Bugti expressed dissatisfaction with the FWO's performance, claiming that projects were handed down to smaller subcontractors leading to poor execution and deteriorated roads in his own area. Speaking at the Turbat Press Club, Buledi defended the FWO by highlighting its invaluable services in constructing highways in the province, noting that multiple personnel lost their lives building the Hoshab-Panjgur-Surab Highway. Buledi criticized political opponents for attempting to create negative narratives against vital infrastructure initiatives like the Hub Industrial Zone, Gwadar Port, Mirani Dam, Gishkor Dam, and the South Balochistan Package. The province's Communication and Works Department has also been reviewing progress on road-sector projects under the Balochistan Socio-Economic Development Programme, with Secretary Babar Khan previously expressing dissatisfaction over slow work progress on critical projects.

stories.title: PCRWR Declares 27 Bottled Water Brands Unsafe Across Pakistan
stories.summary: The Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources has found 27 bottled water brands unsafe for human consumption following nationwide tests. During the July to September 2026 quarter, the council collected and tested 223 bottled water samples from 20 cities to check for chemical and microbiological contamination. Out of the total tested, 195 brands met required quality standards, while 27 failed, with six failing chemical tests and 22 exhibiting microbiological contamination. The unsafe brands identified in the report include Aab-e-Haram, Imperial Pure Drinking Water, Aab-e-Makran, Water Verse Purified, Gel, Sip, AB Blue Water, HR Water Healthy Life, Sufi, Pure Aqua Tech, Aquafine, Water Time, Al-Suha, Aab-e-Hayat, K&S Aqua Sea, Jairs Safe Life, Athar Premium, Aqua Dor, HHG Sweets and Bakers, Drinkly, One Flo, Premium Safa, Zalmi Pure Mineral Water, New A2Z, Fresh Smart Pure Water, and Aqua Indus. The water samples were gathered from 20 cities, including Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Multan, Karachi, Lahore, Quetta, Faisalabad, Sukkur, and Gujranwala.

stories.title: Caitlin Clark Concludes Media Week With Late-Night Appearance And Cheeseball Challenge
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark wrapped up a busy media schedule on Friday night with a guest spot on "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon." During her appearance, she promoted her newly released children's book titled "EXTRAordinary! A Little EXTRA to Reach BIG Dreams" and showcased her inaugural Nike signature shoe collection. Clark presented Fallon with a pair of her signature footwear featuring a Taylor Swift theme, part of a colorway designated as "Friendship Bracelet" that is scheduled for release in February 2027. In addition to discussing her childhood ambition of playing in the WNBA, Clark participated in a 24-second on-air challenge that quickly gained viral attention beyond late-night television viewers. The basketball player successfully landed 12 out of 16 long-distance cheeseballs directly into Fallon's mouth, earning enthusiastic cheers from the studio audience as the timer expired. The WNBA official X account responded to the viral video with praise, commenting that the feat was great. Fans online also reacted warmly to the segment, celebrating the athlete's versatile talents.

The media tour followed Clark's recent promotional appearances earlier in the week on major morning programs including "Good Morning America" and the "Today Show." Her latest projects highlight her growing influence off the court, spanning publishing and athletic apparel partnerships. The intersection of her professional basketball achievements and mainstream entertainment appearances continues to draw significant public interest. By sharing her journey from a childhood dreamer to a professional competitor, Clark leverages her platform to engage diverse audiences. The memorable late-night demonstration further cemented her cultural footprint during an eventful promotional week.

stories.title: US Officials Complete Cultural Preservation Project at Mehrgarh Museum
stories.summary:
US Charge d’Affaires Natalie Baker and Balochistan Parliamentary Secretary Nawabzada Mir Muhammad Zarain Khan Magsi marked the completion of a cultural preservation initiative at the Mehrgarh Museum in Quetta on Saturday. The project was carried out as the first-ever undertaking of the US Ambassadors Fund for Cultural Preservation in Balochistan, working alongside the Sindh Exploration and Adventure Society and the Balochistan Culture Department.

The venture focused on safeguarding ancient Neolithic and archaeological artifacts originating from the 8,000-year-old Mehrgarh civilization. In addition to preserving these historical items, the program successfully upgraded the institution's curation to meet international guidelines, broadened community outreach efforts, and established specialized training programs for local heritage professionals to guarantee long-term collection care.

During the celebratory event in Quetta, Baker, Magsi, and project leads Dr. Asma Ibrahim and Dr. Kaleemullah Lashari revealed a commemorative plaque positioned at the museum entrance. The ceremony took place ahead of the facility's scheduled official reopening later in the month.

This undertaking matters because it highlights international cooperation in safeguarding historical legacies and bolsters diplomatic relations between the United States and Pakistan. By highlighting ancient civilizations, the upgraded museum aims to educate the public and preserve regional heritage for future generations.

stories.title: India Defeats New Zealand by Four Runs in Rain-Interrupted Second ODI
stories.summary:
India secured a narrow four-run victory over New Zealand in a rain-affected second One-Day International on Saturday, taking a two-nil lead in the five-match series. Persistent wet weather in Wellington reduced the contest to a maximum of 47 overs per side, creating treacherous batting conditions throughout the match. New Zealand struggled to defend their modest total of 134 runs before rain halted play permanently. At the stoppage, India had reached 113 for 7 wickets after 26 overs, putting the touring side four runs ahead of the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern par score of 109. KL Rahul remained unbeaten on 26 alongside Auqib Nabi on one run. The teams will travel to Hamilton for the third match on Tuesday, where India will have an opportunity to clinch the series.

The triumph relied heavily on India's seam bowlers, who capitalized on helpful pitch conditions for the second consecutive game. Pacer Gurnoor Brar claimed career-best ODI figures of 4 for 30, earning the player-of-the-match award following his three-wicket performance in the Auckland opener. Brar noted that the extra bounce and pace in New Zealand suited his bowling style compared to flatter pitches in India. Early breakthroughs by New Zealand bowlers Jacob Duffy and Kyle Jamieson had rattled the visitors, removing key batters including captain Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, and top-scorer Shreyas Iyer. New Zealand's innings was anchored by Daryl Mitchell with 55 runs and captain Mitchell Santner with 31 runs, but disciplined bowling and unpredictable bounce restricted the remainder of the lineup. Santner acknowledged the effectiveness of the visiting attack, noting that losing early wickets under challenging weather conditions proved decisive.

stories.title: Pakistan and Sudan Sign Visa-Free Agreement and Expand Security Ties
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Sudan have entered into an official pact enabling holders of diplomatic and official passports to travel freely between both nations without securing visas. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Sudanese counterpart Lieutenant General Babiker Samra Mustafa Ali finalized the agreement during a bilateral meeting held in Islamabad on Saturday.

Alongside the travel exemption, both delegations agreed to broaden institutional cooperation focusing on internal security, police training, cybercrime prevention, and civil registration processes. Sudanese officials expressed a strong desire to adopt Pakistan's expertise regarding cybercrime countermeasures and requested professional training courses for their police officers.

Minister Naqvi also outlined the contributions of the National Database and Registration Authority, noting its historical role in assisting Sudan with the production of millions of identity cards, birth records, death certificates, and citizenship cards. Furthermore, Naqvi instructed authorities to swiftly address visa complications affecting Sudanese women married to Pakistani citizens and extended offers for Sudanese nationals to utilize medical treatment facilities in Pakistan.

This agreement matters as a critical step in strengthening diplomatic and institutional ties between Islamabad and Khartoum. It facilitates high-level communication and delivers tangible assistance to Sudan as the nation focuses on internal reconstruction and security improvements.

stories.title: Gunman Kills Six People and Wounds Dozens in Historic Centre of Krakow
stories.summary:
A shooting incident in the historic center of Krakow, Poland, resulted in six fatalities and approximately a dozen injuries on Saturday. According to police reports, a lone Polish male drove a vehicle onto the city's Main Square and began firing indiscriminately at people. Responding law enforcement officers shot the suspect at the scene, and he was subsequently transported to a hospital while remaining in custody. A local police spokesman confirmed the initial death toll of five people at the scene, while regional authorities and police officials verified the details of the attack on social media. The incident drew an immediate response from emergency services, with ambulances and police vehicles deploying to the landmark tourist area to cordon off the location.

Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the event as a tragic shooting and stated that authorities are investigating the background and circumstances of the attack. European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas also expressed condolences on social media, emphasizing that Poland does not stand alone following the tragedy. The event has placed the nation on heightened concern, following a series of stabbings in October that prompted government warnings regarding a culture of violence. Although deadly shootings are rare in Poland, the country remains vigilant amid ongoing regional tensions. President Karol Nawrocki noted that he is in contact with relevant authorities to await a full explanation of the dramatic events, reiterating that public safety remains an absolute priority.

stories.title: Pakistan Defeats South Korea to Capture Asian Team Squash Championship Title
stories.summary:
Pakistan triumphed over South Korea with a 2-0 victory in the men's final of the 23rd Asian Team Squash Championship held at the Mushaf Squash Complex in Islamabad on Saturday. The decisive win secured the continental title for the host nation through dominant performances by Noor Zaman and Mohammad Asim Khan. Noor Zaman defeated South Korea's Jeongmin Ryu in three straight games with scores of 11-5, 11-7, and 13-11. Shortly after, Mohammad Asim Khan outplayed Seojin Oh by 11-6, 11-5, and 11-4 to seal the championship for Pakistan. The tournament's closing ceremony was attended by prominent figures, including squash legends Gogi Alauddin, Qamar Zaman, and Jansher Khan, alongside Asian Squash Federation Vice-President Adil Jassim Al-Ghareeb and Pakistan Squash Federation President Air Marshal Kazim Hammad.

In the women's division of the championship, Hong Kong China claimed the title by defeating Malaysia 2-1 in the final. The path to the finals featured competitive encounters across various national squads throughout the tournament. Bronze medals in the men's section were awarded to the teams from Hong Kong China and Malaysia, while Iran and Korea secured bronze in the women's category. The successful staging of the event in Islamabad highlighted regional talent and brought together veteran legends alongside emerging competitors to celebrate the sport's traditions in Pakistan.

stories.title: Bushra Bibi Requests Independent Ophthalmologist Examination at Adiala Jail
stories.summary:
Imran Khan's wife, Bushra Bibi, has petitioned the Islamabad High Court for permission to undergo an immediate medical examination by a specialist ophthalmologist of her choice, funded at her own expense. Filed alongside pending appeals for the £190 million Al-Qadir Trust case, the application highlights severe concerns regarding her rapidly worsening eyesight while detained at Adiala Jail.

The legal filing requests the court to compel prison authorities to supply complete medical records and a fresh, detailed report concerning her diagnosis and ongoing care. Barrister Salman Safdar, representing the incarcerated couple, submitted an affidavit detailing a November 2 prison meeting where Bushra appeared distressed, wore unusually dark glasses, and stated she could not tolerate sunlight or artificial light without protective eyewear. According to the plea, examining doctors diagnosed her with a mature cataract and advised an additional operation around November 15.

The former first lady and former prime minister are currently serving prison sentences following convictions handed down by Accountability Court Judge Nasir Javed Rana in January 2025. In that ruling, Imran received a 14-year sentence while Bushra was given seven years alongside financial penalties.

This case matters because it highlights ongoing disputes regarding prison conditions, medical access, and the constitutional rights of high-profile inmates. The petitioner seeks accountability and specialized treatment outside standard prison medical provisions due to dissatisfaction with existing jail facilities.

stories.title: WNBA Star Sophie Cunningham Overtakes Top NBA Players in Instagram Growth
stories.summary:
WNBA free-agent guard Sophie Cunningham has experienced a massive surge in her public profile and social media following, outpacing prominent athletes in the NBA. According to branding firm bknown, Cunningham added approximately 3 million Instagram followers between May 8 and November 2, more than doubling her following from 1,403,868 to 4,356,063. This growth rate surpassed that of any of the top 50 NBA players and exceeded the combined follower growth of the next 49 WNBA players during the same timeframe. Her follower gains also eclipsed individual stars such as Victor Wembanyama, Karl-Anthony Towns, and Jalen Brunson.

Cunningham’s rising popularity is driven by her engaging online presence, which features fashion choices, political beliefs, inspirational quotes, dancing and lip-syncing videos, and behind-the-scenes glimpses into her life. While this openness has expanded her fan base far beyond traditional WNBA audiences, it has also brought challenges; Cunningham revealed on the "No Hesitation" podcast that the increased visibility has forced her to hire security.

As she enters the 2027 offseason following a stint with the Indiana Fever, her next professional basketball move remains undecided. Meanwhile, other basketball figures are also making media rounds, as Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark recently concluded a busy promotional week with an appearance on "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon" to promote her children's book, "EXTRAordinary! A Little EXTRA to Reach BIG Dreams," and her first Nike signature shoe collection.

stories.title: Clashes Erupt Across France During Fourth Weekend of Cost of Living Protests
stories.summary:
Thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across France on Saturday for the fourth consecutive weekend of protests against the rising cost of living. The interior ministry reported a nationwide turnout of 146,000 people, including 46,000 in Paris, while trade unions placed the figures higher at 250,000 nationwide and 75,000 in the capital. The demonstrations occurred as the country approaches presidential elections in five months, with the far-right seeing a strong opportunity to win power.

In Paris, clashes broke out near the end of the march at Place de la Nation. Police deployed tear gas after a group of about 200 violent individuals hurled projectiles and homemade fireworks at security forces while officers attempted to arrest a man who had set fire to a trash bin. Authorities had deployed around 70,000 security personnel nationwide. Meanwhile, a rival demonstration planned by the Yellow Vests movement at Place de la Concorde was banned by authorities, resulting in police surrounding attendees and arresting movement coordinators Benjamin Ball and Azelma Sigaux. In Lyon, police also used tear gas to disperse a crowd blocking a road during an unauthorized gathering.

The protests were initially sparked in late September by high school and university students upset over establishment conditions. Local businesses have suffered due to closed storefronts and barricades, while the government faces severe financial constraints from a massive national debt pile. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu is scheduled to meet with unions and employer federations on Monday to discuss purchasing power, and student and teacher groups have called for a fresh strike on Tuesday to demand increased education spending. In the political sphere, polls indicate far-right candidate Marine Le Pen is a favorite for the 2027 presidency, alongside hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon, who addressed 20,000 supporters at a rally outside Paris on Saturday.

stories.title: IESCO Announces Power Suspension Schedule for Monday Due to Development Works
stories.summary:
The Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO) has announced a temporary power suspension schedule for Monday across various feeders due to ongoing development works by the district administration. The planned outages will affect multiple circles, including Islamabad, Rawalpindi City, Rawalpindi Cantt, Attock, Jhelum, and Chakwal, to facilitate projects such as the construction of flyovers, underpasses, road widening, and the installation of new 11kV feeders.

In the Islamabad Circle, electricity supply will be interrupted on specific feeders during morning and afternoon hours, ranging from 08:00 AM to 02:00 PM and 09:00 AM to 02:00 PM, impacting areas like Scheme-2, Orchard Scheme, Aabpara, E-7, G-10/3, and the Filtration Plant feeders. Similarly, power will remain suspended from 09:00 AM to 02:00 PM across Rawalpindi City Circle feeders such as Gulzar-e-Quaid, Airport, Khanna Road, Pirwadhai, and Jinnah Road, as well as Rawalpindi Cantt Circle feeders including Gracy Line, Kahuta City, Tench Bhatta, and PWD-I and II.

Additional suspensions are scheduled for the Attock, Jhelum, and Chakwal circles between 09:00 AM and 02:00 PM, affecting locations like Sangjani, CMH Jhelum, Gujjar Khan City, Talagang City, and Dandot. IESCO management has formally apologized to consumers for the inconvenience. The utility noted that detailed shutdown schedules have been published on its official website, www.iesco.com.pk, and its social media platforms on Facebook and Twitter/X, while consumers can also reach out via the IESCO helpline at 118 for more information.

stories.title: قصور میں 11 سالہ بچے کو قتل اور زیادتی کا نشانہ بنانے والا ملزم گرفتار
stories.summary:
پولیس نے قصور کے علاقے موضع حسین خانوالا میں گیارہ سالہ بچے کے قتل اور بدفعلی میں ملوث ملزم کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔ ڈسٹرکٹ پولیس آفیسر کے مطابق دو نومبر کو فیضان نامی اس بچے کی لاش ملی تھی جسے قتل کیا گیا تھا۔

حراست میں لیے جانے والے مقامی رہائشی مبشر نے تفتیش کے دوران جرم کا اعتراف کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ وہ چوری کی غرض سے گھر میں داخل ہوا تھا جہاں بچے نے اسے دیکھ لیا تھا۔ ملزم نے اعتراف کیا کہ اس نے رسی کے ذریعے گلا گھونٹ کر بچے کو قتل کیا، لاش فصل میں پھینکی اور قتل کے بعد اس سے بدفعلی بھی کی۔

اس معاملے سے بچے کے اہل خانہ اور علاقے کو گہرا صدمہ پہنچا ہے جبکہ پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ملزم کو دبوچ لیا ہے۔ ملزم کا اپنے جرم کا اعتراف کرنے کے بعد اب اسے قانون کے مطابق کڑی سزاؤں کا سامنا کرنا ہوگا۔

پولیس حکام اس گھناؤنے جرم کی تمام پہلوؤں سے مزید جانچ پڑتال کر رہے ہیں تاکہ انصاف کے تقاضے پورے کیے جا سکیں۔ اس کارروائی سے علاقے کے مکینوں میں پھیلی خوف کی فضا کو کسی حد تک سکون ملا ہے۔

stories.title: پشاور ہائی کورٹ نے گورنر راج اور گرفتاریوں کی درخواستیں کاز لسٹ سے ہٹا دیں
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا میں گورنر راج اور ایمرجنسی کے نفاذ کے خلاف دائر کردہ درخواستوں کے حوالے سے وفاقی آئینی عدالت کے فیصلے پر عملدرآمد شروع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ پشاور ہائی کورٹ نے دس نومبر کی مقررہ کاز لسٹ سے گورنر راج، سابق وزیر اعلیٰ کی گرفتاری اور اس نوعیت کے دیگر تمام کیسز خارج کر دیے ہیں۔

عدالت کے اس نئے فیصلے کے تحت بارہ اکتوبر دو ہزار چھبیس یا اس کے بعد دائر ہونے والی اس طرح کی کوئی بھی درخواست اب سماعت کے لیے پیش نہیں کی جائے گی۔ گورنر راج اور ایمرجنسی کے خلاف پٹیشنز، سابق وزیر اعلیٰ اور اسپیکر خیبر پختونخوا اسمبلی کی گرفتاری کے معاملات سمیت تھری ایم پی او کی درخواستیں اب پشاور ہائی کورٹ میں نہیں سنی جائیں گی۔

ان تمام قانونی امور کی سماعت اب صرف وفاقی آئینی عدالت کی ذمہ داری ہوگی، جس کے پیش نظر صوبائی عدالت نے اپنے یہاں سے یہ مقدمات ہٹا دیے ہیں۔ اس اقدام کا مقصد عدالتی دائرہ کار اور آئینی عدالت کے فیصلوں کی مکمل پاسداری کو یقینی بنانا ہے۔

مختلف سیاسی شخصیات اور معاملات سے جڑی ان درخواستوں کے منتقل ہونے سے قانونی حلقوں میں نئی بحث چھڑ گئی ہے۔ متعلقہ فریقین اب ان مقدمات کی پیروی کے لیے وفاقی آئینی عدالت سے رجوع کریں گے۔

stories.title: Environmental Groups Adopt Artificial Intelligence Despite Warnings Over Data Center Emissions
stories.summary:
Conservation and environmental groups around the world are increasingly utilizing artificial intelligence to analyze climate data, monitor forest fires, and track endangered wildlife. Organizations such as Conservation International use AI to assess satellite wildfire hotspots and alert community forest patrols in Cambodia. In Kenya, Save the Elephants employs machine learning to evaluate population surveys and study elephant communication, discovering through aerial data that human surveys previously missed a significant portion of local wildlife. Similarly, the Jane Goodall Institute is using AI tools developed with Amazon Web Services to digitize decades of handwritten field notes regarding chimpanzee behavior in Tanzania's Gombe National Park in a fraction of the originally estimated time.

Despite these benefits, these same organizations acknowledge a major contradiction: the technology is driving a massive surge in global electricity demand, water consumption, and greenhouse gas emissions. Data centers housing servers require vast resources for power and cooling. Research from the United Nations University Institute for Water, Environment and Health estimates that the global data-center footprint could more than double by 2030, reaching twice the size of Jakarta. The International Energy Agency projects that data centers will consume about 945 terawatt-hours of electricity annually by 2030—producing over 300 million metric tons of carbon dioxide—while water consumption is expected to climb to 1.2 trillion liters annually.

Technology giants like Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet's Google have reported rising emissions linked to data center expansion. To mitigate these impacts, some environmental groups are adopting internal guidelines and resource-saving strategies. The World Resources Institute limits heavy applications like video and image generation, The Nature Conservancy installs AI-powered digital cameras directly on commercial fishing vessels to process data locally rather than uploading massive files to centralized centers, and Greenpeace International is pushing back against the rapid buildout of massive data facilities altogether.

stories.title: Pakistani Startup RLabs Wins Top Award at Silicon Valley Summit
stories.summary:
A Pakistani startup named RLabs has received the GOAL Startup Award at the Silicon Valley November Summit held in California from November 2 to 5. Led by Harris Ahmed, a 2018 graduate of the National University of Sciences and Technology and incubated at the National Incubation Centre for Aerospace Technologies, RLabs was among 18 international startups chosen to pitch their ideas through Plug and Play’s Global Overseas Acceleration & Learning programme.

Ahmed presented work focused on extended reality simulators, synthetic data, and machine training at the event, which brought together over 3,000 attendees, including venture capitalists and corporate executives. According to the incubation centre, RLabs has been training a proprietary Large Language Model to power a modular simulation engine that reduces development time by 75 percent.

Government officials praised the achievement as a reflection of the rising capabilities of Pakistan's startup sector. IT Minister Shaza Fatima Khawaja congratulated the team, stating that homegrown startups should aim to shape global technology rather than merely compete internationally.

The recognition follows recent national technological developments in Pakistan, including Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's inauguration of the Daanish IT Park. Additionally, future support is anticipated from the World Bank through an upcoming entrepreneurship project aimed at establishing a $50 million Fund of Funds to back the local venture capital ecosystem.

stories.title: US Military Launches Task Force Iron Gate to Restrict Iranian Land Commerce
stories.summary:
The United States military has announced the creation of a new task force aimed at curbing Tehran's transport of sanctioned materials and advanced weapons across its land borders and through the Caspian Sea. Dubbed Task Force Iron Gate, the initiative will be headquartered in Tampa, Florida, and will coordinate with multiple US government agencies to halt dual-use technologies and illegal revenue streams.

This move builds upon an ongoing naval blockade led by the US against Iran, following an ongoing conflict that began more than eight months ago involving the US and Israel. While the naval strategy has severely limited crude exports through the Arabian Sea and the Strait of Hormuz, investigators revealed that Iran has utilized a covert network to import over $2 billion in military hardware, explosives, and heavy-duty trucks since January 2025 by evading both Western sanctions and the maritime blockade.

According to US Central Command, the newly formed task force will collaborate with interagency partners including the State, Treasury, and Justice Departments, as well as the intelligence community. Admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of Central Command, stated that this enhanced interagency cooperation will further restrict Iran's capacity to finance terrorism and rebuild its military infrastructure.

The broader conflict has faced political headwinds, including recent US midterm elections that shifted congressional control to Democrats amid domestic debate over the war's value. Meanwhile, international mediators have been stepping up efforts to prevent the conflict from escalating further, as threats of regional retaliation continue to keep Gulf nations on edge despite intelligence assessments indicating that renewed strikes would not alter Tehran's fundamental negotiating posture.

stories.title: Nepra Increases Industrial Tariff to Rs25.30 Amid Dissent and Deadlock
stories.summary:
The National Electric Power Regulatory Authority has revised a special electricity tariff for industrial consumers, raising the incremental support package rate to Rs25.30 per unit. The decision followed a delayed request from the Power Division regarding the package, which was originally introduced last December to stimulate industrial activity.

The regulatory body was divided during the decision-making process. Two board members, Amina Ahmed and Maqsood Anwar, strongly dissented, arguing that the true marginal cost sits at Rs31.83 per unit and recommending the temporary suspension of the package due to a lack of validated data from the Ministry of Energy.

Despite the 2-2 deadlock among the four members, Nepra Chairman Waseem Mukhtar utilized his casting vote to approve the Rs25.30 per unit rate. While acknowledging the serious concerns raised by the dissenting members, the chairman noted that outright suspension was inappropriate and opted to grant the ministry additional time to provide requested calculations.

In addition to the industrial tariff revision, Nepra authorized power distribution companies to charge all consumers an extra Rs2.37 per unit on their November bills. This fuel cost adjustment aims to recover an additional 25 billion rupees across the system.

stories.title: میر رضا ہلاکت کیس: جبران نامی وکیل نے ایس ایچ او فیروزآباد کے کردار پر سوالات اٹھا دیے
stories.summary:
مقتول میر رضا کے والد کے قانونی نمائندے جبران ناصر ایڈووکیٹ نے میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے ایس ایچ او فیروز آباد، احمد اور عبداللہ بھاردے کے کردار کی گہرائی سے تحقیقات کا پرزور مطالبہ کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ خاندان کے تحفظات متعلقہ حکام کے سامنے رکھ دیے گئے ہیں اور توقع ہے کہ آئندہ کی تفتیش زیادہ بہتر انداز میں آگے بڑھے گی۔

میر رضا کیس کی تشکیل کردہ جوائنٹ انویسٹی گیشن ٹیم کا پہلا اجلاس کراچی میں ڈی آئی جی ویسٹ عرفان بلوچ کی سربراہی میں منعقد ہوا۔ اس اہم اجلاس میں آئی ایس آئی، آئی بی، پاکستان رینجرز اور این سی سی آئی اے کے نمائندوں کے علاوہ مقتول کے والدین، سابق تفتیشی افسر اور کمیٹی کے ارکان کو بھی طلب کیا گیا تھا۔

یاد رہے کہ میر رضا علی خان اٹھائیس جولائی کو پی ای سی ایچ ایس سے اچانک لاپتہ ہوئے تھے اور ان کی لاش دو روز بعد گلستان جوہر سے برآمد ہوئی تھی جو کہ سینے پر گولی مار کر اور بری حالت میں ملی تھی۔ اس المناک واقعے سے قبل ان کے تمام سوشل میڈیا اکاؤنٹس بھی بند کر دیے گئے تھے جبکہ ان کا تیس اگست کو نکاح طے تھا۔

پولیس نے اس معاملے میں ٹیکسی ڈرائیور سمیت مختلف ذرائع سے شواہد اکٹھے کیے ہیں اور فون ریکارڈز کا ڈیٹا بھی طلب کیا گیا ہے۔ جے آئی ٹی کی اس انکوائری سے مقتول کے اہل خانہ کو انصاف ملنے کی توقع ہے۔

stories.title: مصدق ملک کا کہنا ہے کہ دس کروڑ کی گاڑی خریدنے والا ٹیکس بھی دے سکتا ہے
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر موسمیاتی تبدیلی سینیٹر مصدق ملک نے ایک ٹی وی پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ حکومت کو متوسط طبقے کی گاڑیوں پر عائد اضافی ٹیکس کا بوجھ کم کرنا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے دوٹوک الفاظ میں کہا کہ جو شخص آٹھ سے دس کروڑ روپے مالیت کی مہنگی گاڑی خرید سکتا ہے، وہ ریاست کو ٹیکس بھی باآسانی ادا کر سکتا ہے۔

مصدق ملک نے موجودہ آٹو پالیسی کی تعریف کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اس پر وزیراعظم، نائب وزیراعظم، مشیر ہارون اختر اور ان کی پوری ٹیم خراج تحسین کی مستحق ہے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ دنیا بھر میں سولر اور الیکٹرک گاڑیوں کا رجحان تیزی سے بڑھ رہا ہے اور پاکستان کو بھی اسی سمت میں قدم اٹھانا چاہئے۔

ان کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ الیکٹرک گاڑیوں اور سولر سسٹمز کے فروغ سے ملک میں ایندھن کی درآمدات میں کمی آئے گی جس کے نتیجے میں بجلی کی قیمتوں میں بھی کمی واقع ہوگی۔ وزیراعظم کی ہدایت کے مطابق لگژری گاڑیوں کو کوئی ریلیف نہیں دیا جائے گا بلکہ ٹیکس میں چھوٹ اور ریلیف صرف مڈل کلاس اور سستی گاڑیوں کے خریداروں کو ملے گا۔

حکومت نے براؤزرز اور برآمدکنندگان کے لیے بھی مالی اقدامات کیے ہیں جبکہ گاڑیوں کی قیمتوں میں کمی کا مقصد مسابقت کو بڑھانا ہے۔ اس پالیسی سے عام آدمی کو براہ راست فائدہ پہنچنے کی توقع ظاہر کی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Gunman Kills Five and Wounds Dozen in Historic Krakow Square
stories.summary:
A tragic shooting occurred in the historic center of Krakow, Poland, where a lone gunman opened fire and killed five people while wounding approximately a dozen others. The assailant drove a vehicle onto the city's Main Square and began shooting randomly at individuals before being shot by police officers and taken into custody at a hospital. A Krakow police spokesperson confirmed that the perpetrator is a Polish man who acted alone, prompting emergency services and numerous police vehicles to respond to the landmark tourist destination.

Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk described the incident as tragic and stated that authorities are investigating the background and circumstances surrounding the attack. The country has recently been on high alert following a series of stabbings in October, which Tusk previously condemned as a cult of violence. Deadly shootings remain rare in Poland, an EU and NATO member state with a population of 38 million.

Krakow, a major southern city and Poland's former capital, draws millions of visitors annually, recording 16.2 million tourists in 2025. President Karol Nawrocki noted on social media that he is in contact with relevant authorities to secure a full explanation of the events, emphasizing that public safety remains an absolute priority for the nation.

Witnesses described seeing the armed individual walking around the square and targeting people, marking an unprecedented tragedy for the local community. Police have cordoned off the area as investigations continue into why the suspect carried out the assault in the popular tourist and local hotspot.

stories.title: Pakistan Railways Plans Expansion of Freight Operations and Dry Port
stories.summary:
Pakistan Railways is working to increase its operational freight train count to 14 by January 2027 to satisfy growing demands from the business sector and enhance overall revenues. The strategic decision was finalized during a meeting held at the Railways Headquarters and led by Federal Minister for Railways Muhammad Hanif Abbasi.

Alongside the fleet expansion, officials authorized the creation of a brand-new dry port located in Khanewal, intended to bolster cargo handling capabilities and generate supplementary income. These measures form a core component of the department's wider strategy to upgrade its financial standing and scale up rail-based logistics.

In an effort to improve safety and operational accountability, authorities announced plans to request a Federal Investigation Agency probe into the responsibility of train examiners regarding mechanical failures and accidents. Furthermore, five new weighbridges will be installed across the nation by December 31 to tackle the issue of overloaded trains.

Minister Abbasi also instructed officials to decentralize operational meetings by conducting them at the divisional level instead of the headquarters to boost overall performance. Additional administrative decisions included phasing out DVM and DVS coaches and running sleeper manufacturing facilities across two shifts to elevate production levels.

stories.title: Pakistan Introduces New Auto Policy to Boost Vehicle Exports and EVs
stories.summary:
Pakistan has officially launched a comprehensive automotive policy with the objective of expanding vehicle exports thirtyfold, moving from $200 million up to $6 billion. The framework was presented by Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Haroon Akhtar Khan, the Prime Minister’s Advisor on Industries and Production, during a press conference.

Formulated after extensive consultations and personal oversight by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the policy rests on six foundational pillars: affordable vehicles for middle- and lower-middle-income families, export growth, localization, safety standards, electric vehicle promotion, and administrative transparency. Officials noted that revised tariff structures will gradually lower production costs and reduce vehicle prices over a five-year period, though luxury models are excluded.

To ensure accountability, automotive manufacturers will be bound by strict export quotas, with financial penalties enforced against companies that fail to meet these established targets. Additionally, car makers are now prohibited from collecting advance bookings exceeding 20 percent of a vehicle's total cost, and 45 new quality standards have been integrated to align local assemblies with international benchmarks.

The policy places a strong emphasis on electric vehicles to counter oil price fluctuations and curb carbon emissions, raising the financing limit for EV purchases from Rs. 2 million to Rs. 10 million while cutting import duties on charging stations. The government believes these steps will transform Pakistan into a regional automotive export hub while generating domestic employment.

stories.title: US Establishes Task Force Iron Gate to Restrict Iranian Land Commerce
stories.summary:
The United States military has announced the creation of a new unit called Task Force Iron Gate to limit Iran's transportation of advanced weaponry and sanctioned materials across land borders and the Caspian Sea. Based in Tampa, Florida, and operating under the United States Central Command (Centcom), the 20-person civilian and military team will coordinate with other government agencies to curb illegal trade routes. Centcom stated that the unit aims to stop ground transport of dual-use technologies and illicit revenue streams.

Admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of Centcom, noted that the initiative builds upon the success of an ongoing naval blockade against Iran. According to Centcom figures, the maritime blockade has already stopped Tehran from exporting more than $25 billion worth of crude oil. The formation of Task Force Iron Gate represents another step in increasing logistical and economic pressure following a reduction in direct hostilities.

This measure follows prior economic pressure campaigns launched by Washington, including Operation Economic Outcast introduced in August by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. That campaign targeted five sectors utilized by Tehran to sustain its economy, namely digital assets, gold, technology, aviation, and shipping. Additionally, US President Donald Trump reimposed a naval blockade in June across the Strait of Hormuz targeting all vessel traffic along the Iranian coastline, though humanitarian shipments and neutral transit remain permitted.

Despite these extensive restrictions, Tehran has continued to successfully export oil and liquefied natural gas. The United States maintains that its broader objective is to eliminate all financial lifelines supporting the Iranian regime until the country stands completely isolated on the global stage.

stories.title: Paraguay Central Bank Begins Advance Payouts to Ueno Bank Depositors
stories.summary:
Paraguay's Central Bank has initiated advance financial payouts to depositors who lost access to their funds following the sudden takeover of Ueno Bank earlier in the week. The abrupt seizure of the digital lender blocked accounts belonging to roughly half of the nation's population, sparking severe street protests in Asuncion.

Jose Maciel, an official from the Central Bank's Deposit Guarantee Fund, confirmed that the reimbursement process kicked off on Thursday afternoon. The initial phase prioritizes clients holding deposits of up to approximately $1,600 who do not have active loans and maintain an account at another domestic financial institution. Subsequent groups of beneficiaries will be disclosed progressively as the payout schedule advances.

The intervention occurred due to mounting solvency concerns surrounding Ueno, a firm that originated as a digital-first fintech before expanding into a major institution managing state pensions and government accounts. The crisis has triggered intense political fallout, leaving President Santiago Pena facing impeachment over conflict-of-interest allegations due to his past stake in the group controlling Ueno, which he has denied.

stories.title: Pakistan Information Commission Orders NA Secretariat to Disclose Committee Expenses
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Information Commission (PIC) has instructed the National Assembly Secretariat to release comprehensive financial details regarding allowances, perks, and expenditures of parliamentary committees. Issued by Chief Information Commissioner Shoaib Ahmad Siddiqui and Information Commissioner Ijaz Hassan Awan, the directive stems from an appeal filed by journalist Saddia Mazhar. The PIC ordered the NA secretary to provide explicit responses to 13 unresolved questions under the Right of Access to Information Act 2017 within a 10-day window.

The case began when Mazhar submitted an information request on June 21 seeking data from January 2025 onward regarding committee meetings, total expenditures, member travel allowances, and lawmaker privileges. After receiving no adequate reply, she filed an appeal on July 5. During the proceedings, Litigation Officer Sehrish Mushtaq represented the NA Secretariat, which maintained that relevant data was already available on the official website. However, the PIC determined that published online material failed to answer the specific questions raised by the applicant.

The commission emphasized that public bodies must furnish direct and objective replies to information requests in compliance with the RTI Act, regardless of whether general information exists online. Consequently, the PIC directed compliance for questions numbered 2 through 14 and scheduled implementation proceedings for November 19 to verify adherence. Under Section 11 of the legislation, citizens are legally entitled to request disclosable records such as benefits, agreements, and licenses from official bodies.

stories.title: چوہدری سالک نے این اے 77 میں حمایت کی تردید کر دی
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر برائے سمندر پاکستانیز اور انسانی وسائل کی ترقی اور مسلم لیگ (ق) کے مرکزی رہنما چوہدری سالک حسین نے گوجرانوالہ کے قومی اسمبلی کے حلقہ این اے 77 کے ضمنی انتخاب میں قاضی ابراہیم گجر کی حمایت کے اعلان سے متعلق زیر گردش خبروں کو سختی سے مسترد کر دیا ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ انہوں نے نہ تو کسی امیدوار کی حمایت کی ہے اور نہ ہی اس سلسلے میں ان کی پارٹی کے کسی عہدیدار سے کوئی بات چیت ہوئی ہے۔

یہ نشست مسلم لیگ ن کے رکن قومی اسمبلی محمود بشیر ورک کے انتقال کے باعث خالی ہوئی تھی، جس پر ضمنی انتخاب کے لیے میدان کل سجے گا۔ دریں اثنا، دیگر ملکی اور سیاسی خبروں میں یہ بات سامنے آئی ہے کہ وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی اور سوڈان کے وزیر داخلہ لیفٹیننٹ جنرل بابکر سمرہ مصطفیٰ علی نے ایک معاہدے پر دستخط کیے ہیں جس کے تحت دونوں ممالک کے سرکاری اور سفارتی پاسپورٹس کے حامل افراد کو ویزا فری انٹری کی سہولت میسر ہوگی۔

اس کے علاوہ، مختلف شہروں میں پیش آنے والے دیگر واقعات کے دوران کراچی ساؤتھ پولیس نے لودھراں سے کراچی آنے والی دو لڑکیوں کو بازیاب کرا لیا ہے جبکہ کراچی کی شاہراہ قائدین پر ایک شہری سے کروڑوں روپے مالیت کا سونا اور چاندی لوٹنے کا مقدمہ بھی درج کر لیا گیا ہے۔ دوسری جانب، اسلام آباد کی ضلعی انتظامیہ کی جانب سے مشکوک الیکٹرانک ڈیوائسز ملنے پر چار پیٹرول پمپس کے خلاف مقدمات درج کیے گئے ہیں۔

امریکہ کے حوالے سے بھی اہم سفارتی سرگرمیاں دیکھنے میں آئیں جہاں امریکی ناظم الامور نیٹلی بیکر نے بلوچستان کے پارلیمانی سیکریٹری نواب زادہ میر محمد زرین خان مگسی اور سندھ ایکسپلوریشن اینڈ ایڈونچر سوسائٹی کی قیادت کے ساتھ مل کر مہر گڑھ عجائب گھر بلوچستان کے لیے امریکن ایمبیسیڈرز فنڈ فار کلچرل پریزرویشن پروجیکٹ کی کام یاب تکمیل پر منعقدہ تقریب میں شرکت کی۔ ان تمام پیش رفتوں سے ملک بھر کی سیاسی اور انتظامی صورتحال پر گہرے اثرات مرتب ہو رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Punjab Launches Pakistan's First Electric Road Sweeper Truck to Curb Pollution
stories.summary:
Punjab has rolled out the country's inaugural fully electric mechanical sweeper truck for cleaning and washing roads, a step designed to cut pollution and advance green municipal services. Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif officially introduced the machine, examined its functions, and observed a live demonstration while receiving a detailed project briefing.

Initially, authorities will deploy this electric broomer on the Lahore Ring Road. Officials highlighted that this vehicle represents a domestic first by being equipped to both vacuum and extract water from road surfaces. Powered by a single charge, the truck can cover up to 70 kilometers.

Operating with zero carbon emissions, the cleaner aims to diminish atmospheric contamination while minimizing roadside dust. Additionally, the quiet nature of the electric vehicle is projected to lower noise pollution.

Beyond environmental benefits, the administration anticipates that the new technology will substantially decrease maintenance and fuel expenditures.

stories.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio Tightens Controls Against Conflicts of Interest
stories.summary:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has instructed senior officials at the State Department to stay within their operational bounds and avoid conflicts of interest. The directive followed the mid-October resignation of US Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle amid allegations that she sold access to Trump administration officials for money, gifts, and favors, claims she has denied. During a meeting with about two dozen assistant secretaries of state, Rubio warned that unethical behavior would lead to termination regardless of connections, while also mandating his office's approval for all political travel.

In connection with management controls, Jeremy Lewin, the State Department's policy chief who joined from Elon Musk's Department of Government Efficiency, was pushed out of his job shortly after the meeting due to concerns over working outside his designated area without proper coordination. While Lewin denied being fired and stated he resigned voluntarily to return to the private sector and plan his wedding, three sources confirmed his departure was due to leadership frustrations over freelancing and ignoring directives. Additionally, US Special Representative for Global Partnerships Paolo Zampolli was fired in October after Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau accused him of working outside his cultural diplomacy remit.

Rubio's internal clampdown occurs as the Republican Party attempts to distance itself from an increasingly unpopular Trump administration following electoral losses in the midterm elections. The 2028 presidential race has begun to take shape, with figures like Vice President JD Vance and Senator Ted Cruz offering post-mortems on social media, while Rubio has not ruled out a potential run. Meanwhile, Democrats have announced plans to launch official investigations in January to scrutinize dealings between Trump aides and foreign officials when they take control of Congress.

The administration has consistently denied allegations of self-dealing. Rubio also sent a department-wide memo in October reminding diplomats to avoid conflicts of interest, though he maintained it was delayed for bureaucratic reasons rather than being prompted by Guilfoyle's exit. As leadership navigates upcoming congressional oversight and the shifting political landscape, management of the State Department could become a prominent topic on the campaign trail.

stories.title: NADRA Outlines CNIC Application Rules for Individuals Lacking B-Forms
stories.summary:
The National Database and Registration Authority has detailed the exact protocol for securing an initial Computerized National Identity Card for citizens who lack a birth certificate or a B-Form. The agency released these guidelines to assist first-time applicants navigating the registration process.
